notes.title: Update 1.14
notes.notes: Gameplay has been tweaked and improved.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes:
In the previous updates new obstacles and other changes have been added. This time the look of the game was improved.

Thank you for playing Square!

notes.title: Update 1.02 and 1.03
notes.notes:
On top of the new obstacles and tweaks from the first update, we have another set of new obstacles. The game is now more fun than ever!

Thank you all for playing.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Thank you all for playing Square!

In this update more obstacles were added and some existing ones were improved. The gameplay is now more interesting and fun. On top of that various parts of the game were tweaked.

I invite you to try the new changes.
